shortBio.en: Beatles bassist/songwriter who continued with Wings (1971–81) after the Beatles ended.
shortBio.zh: Beatles 贝斯手/词曲作者；Beatles 结束后以 Wings（1971–81）延续。

whyHub.en: Beatles → Wings: clearest logo-change case where listeners still follow one writer’s ear.
whyHub.zh: Beatles → Wings：听众仍跟随同一写作者耳朵的最清晰 logo 更换案例。

body.en:
Born 1942. Inside The Beatles: melody engine, bass melodic lines, co-writing with Lennon. Wings rebuilds a touring/pop-rock vehicle under a new name—Band on the Run as the usual citation.

Teach beginners that bands end and songwriting continues; person > brand in the graph.
body.zh:
1942 年生。在 Beatles 内：旋律引擎、旋律化贝斯、与 Lennon 合写。Wings 在新名称下重建巡演/流行摇滚载具——Band on the Run 为常见引用。

教初学者：乐队会结束，写作继续；图谱里人物 > 品牌。
